headline: Bruins dominate Florida as Patriots fall in brutal Sunday blowout
morning_brew: Sunday was a total rollercoaster of emotions for every one of us in the Hub. The Bruins finally gave us something to cheer about at the Garden, putting on a clinic against the Panthers with a 4-1 win that actually felt like hockey. It was a testy affair from the opening puck drop, but the boys responded with three goals in the first period to set the tone. Elias Lindholm, Michael Eyssimont, and Morgan Geekie all found the back of the net early, and Jeremy Swayman was a brick wall in the crease, turning aside forty of forty-one shots to keep Florida at bay all afternoon. I sat there watching the second and third periods thinking that for once, nobody was trying to give me an ulcer.

Over at Gillette Stadium, the mood was a whole lot darker after the Patriots dropped a 45-27 heartbreaker to the Packers. It was a tough one to stomach, especially watching the defense look like a bunch of traffic cones while the offense fought uphill for most of the day. Drake Maye put up three scores through the air, but three costly interceptions made it nearly impossible to climb back into contention. My neighbor Rick is already deep into his umpire dossier, and today he shifted his focus to the officiating in Foxborough, swearing on his life that the league has a massive vendetta against our secondary. I don't know about a vendetta, but I do know the defense couldn't stop a nosebleed out there.

Looking ahead, the C's are heading to Philadelphia on Tuesday to keep their win streak alive. They are coming off a solid 117-97 road win against Milwaukee, where the ball movement looked like the vintage team basketball we've come to expect. It's gonna be a big test against a 76ers team that's been sitting right at the top of the East, but if we play with the kind of defensive intensity we showed Sunday, I like our chances. We've got a busy week of hoops ahead, and I'll be glued to the screen for every second of it, assuming my heart can take it after this weekend.
